text: Optical engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the generation, transmission, control and application of light. It integrates physics, materials science, electronics and computer technology, aiming to solve technical problems of light in fields such as imaging, communication, sensing and processing. From traditional optical instrument design to modern laser technology and photonic integration, this major covers directions such as optical system design, optoelectronic information processing, and opto-mechatronics integration, aiming to cultivate compound talents with a solid theoretical foundation in optics and practical engineering capabilities.
